digest.component_or_area: rebar repository codebase health audit (janitor pipeline)
propositions: Rebar repository requires systematic code-debt and architectural-smell audit covering 12 concerns: code debt, smells, separation-of-concerns, spent optionality, documentation gaps, oversized units, weak test oracles, AI-generated code, security smells, and temporal decay.

Phase 1 discovery pooled 113 raw findings across 12 concern shards (4 comment, 3 test-suite, 3 oracle, 1 temporal-decay); Phase 2 verification produced 47 survivors (29 critical, 18 major) and 31 explicit drops after applying validity/impact floors.

Phase 3 remediation converged 47 survivors into 37 ordered RP items (29 agent-converged, 4 research-resolved, 4 no-consensus) with asymmetric evidence-based proposals from community practice and project record.

Approved remediation work (RP01, RP02-refined, RP05, RP06, RP07-refined, RP09, RP10-refined) maps to existing epic financial-stoneware-brant with new child tickets piscine-bullish-cowbird and gnarled-wraithlike-flatfish; rejected items RP04 and RP08 preserved as deferred ideas without known-fine blessing.

Audit artifacts persisted at .joe-janitor/report-2026-08-29.md with playbook appended to .joe-janitor/tools.md; no production, test, config, or docs code modified outside janitor tree; all decisions recorded with explicit handoff comments to relevant epic/story owners.
